facts.statement: In the birthday event Cakenstein's cakelings try to steal the birthday cake, and the player must stop them with fireworks before they can be hit.
facts.quote: Il faut d'abord les empêcher en utilisant le feu d'artifice.

article_summaries.title: Guide d'Anniversaire par l'Arbitre Ruby - Première Partie!
article_summaries.summary: Part one of a French-language guide to the Free Realms 1st-anniversary birthday event, in which players help Camellia and Chef Jarvie, gather ingredients for Glerga's cake, and fight the cake monster Gâtostein (Cakenstein) and its cakelings. The page gives the event flow and says the monster must be defeated 7 times, but no numbers beyond that, and the posting date is only relative ('1 year, 1 month ago') so the exact date is unknown.
